_comment: Merchant room (GDD 5, #6): one merchant per floor, a seeded pick weighted by floor_pick. Archibald's stock rules; Malphas's tithe options and contract pool. Prices in balance.merchant.

blacksmith._comment: #77 Rolf Hult's forge: a sealed leaf chamber on floor_chance of the floors (seeded). layout: cell offsets from the room centre ('wall': from its top row) plus a pixel nudge for each piece; pieces: the prop type of each. upgrade: one step raises an item's level by 'step' up to min(hero level, floor item level + cap_above_floor); gold per step (#92: base 15, was 10) = base x rarity_mult[rarity - 1] x (1 + per_level x (ilvl - 1))^level_exponent x the item's quality x party_price[heroes - 1] (gold piles are split between the heroes; checked against a floor's gold by BalanceSuite.forge_probe). anim: the smith's idle, frame times in seconds.
blacksmith.name: Rolf Hult
blacksmith.title: Ironhand of the Galt Works

archibald._comment: #93: equipment pieces per floor, their rarity by weight (Uncommon..Relic), item level = the floor's + a roll in ilvl_above, the base drawn with party_class_weight for the party's classes (loot uses loot.party_class_weight); consumables: count of each on sale.
archibald.name: Archibald the Gilded

anim._comment: #113: looping idle, a gesture every rest seconds (NpcAnim merchant mode); frame times in seconds.

archibald._buyback: #114: how many of the items each hero sold him this floor Archibald keeps to sell back (newest first)

malphas.name: Malphas the Soul Broker

anim._comment: #113: looping idle, a gesture every rest seconds (NpcAnim merchant mode).

malphas._offer: #95: every floor Malphas offers contracts_per_floor stat exchanges and pacts_per_floor pact potions, both seeded picks; each hero signs a contract and buys a potion once a floor.
